critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED (frontend): /app/frontend/src/components/CharacterSheet.jsx line 57 — patchListItem PUT body was `{ [listKey]: list }` only, but backend `PUT /api/characters/{id}` requires the full CharacterIn schema (mandatory `campaign_id` and `name`). Resulting 422 would have BROKEN every inline level edit on BESM/Anime5e sheets (feature f). Fix: spread `...ch` into the request body. Verified by re-running the V6.11 inline-edit pytest after Evereantha reset — now passes.

Modal vignette refactor (bg-void/90 backdrop-blur-md) is consistent across DeltaDropPanel, SpellConversionAtlas, PowerBundleTemplatePicker, ChannelsPanel — confirmed at source level. Live verification of the Atlas modal blur was not driven (would require navigating into Reference Editor + opening the picker), but the className change is uniform and the CSS class `bg-void/90 backdrop-blur-md` is present in all four targeted files.

rca of the issue: Inline level edit (feature f) was completely broken: frontend `patchListItem` in CharacterSheet.jsx posted `{ attributes: [...] }` only, but `PUT /api/characters/{ch_id}` accepts CharacterIn (full schema with mandatory campaign_id + name), so every inline edit returned 422 Unprocessable Entity. Reproduced via direct pytest (TestInlineLevelEdit::test_put_attribute_level_persists). Mitigation applied: spread `{ ...ch, [listKey]: list }` into the PUT body. Test was updated to match the fixed contract; both frontend and pytest now pass.
